I'm putting next week's CSE455 staff meeting on the calendar. My own week is packed hour to hour, so could you tell me which days and times work for you next week?

If you have a preferred slot, send it and I'll book it; otherwise propose two or three and I'll fit the best one around the department's official schedule.

— Prof. Alvarez

Hello,

This is Professor Alvarez. I'm setting up next week's CSE455 staff meeting (one hour, within 09:00-17:00, Monday to Friday).

Could you send me the official schedule for next week — lectures, seminars and university meetings — and let me know whether there is a free slot for that staff meeting, and which room is available?

Thank you,
Prof. Alvarez

Hi Professor Alvarez,

I went through next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) against my own commitments. My days are booked back to back, so the only windows I have inside working hours (09:00–17:00) are:

1. Tuesday 15:00-15:30

If 30 minutes is enough for the staff meeting, take whichever of those fits your week best — Wednesday morning is my favourite, since it sits right before my office hours. If you need a longer block, tell me how long and I'll see whether I can move something of mine; I'd also be glad to check the department's official schedule before we settle on a slot.

— Sarah
